title: Text: DET Jordan Field ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I know Mary was blowing you up yesterday about the HOF stuff. Thank you for your patience
No worries at all.  I thought your story today was great.  As a board member I don’t vote (the board just ratifies the vote) but I’m definitely pulling for Mary.
Thank you. How are you and the fam doing?
Entirely welcome.  We are home, safe and healthy, thankfully. Working from home and staying busy. We miss baseball but I can’t complain. Very nice of you to ask. How are you and your loved ones?
Everyone is good, just a different time. Been grocery shopping for my parents. Stay safe
Happy to hear.  Thanks, Anthony.  Same to you.
